Subject: Phase 4: Agent Desktop (Web)
Description:
Develop the web-based agent desktop for call handling and CRM integration.

# High-Level Design (HLD)
- React 18 + Next.js (App Router)
- WebRTC for browser-based audio
- SIP.js or JsSIP for signaling
- WebSocket for real-time state updates
- Zustand/Redux for state management
- Tailwind CSS for UI
- Component-based architecture (Container-Presenter)

# Architecture Decisions
- Use WebRTC for all audio (no external softphone required)
- Implement a robust WebRTC adapter for browser compatibility
- Centralized state for agent status and active calls
- Real-time event handling via WebSockets
- Responsive design for various screen sizes

# Deliverables
- packages/web/src/components/softphone
- packages/web/src/hooks/useWebRTC.ts
- packages/web/src/store/agentStore.ts
- packages/web/src/services/websocket.service.ts
- Agent login and status management UI
